title: Ice Breaking
place: Lake Baikal (per page tags 'Lake Baikal'; not stated as a location field)
people: hands in gloves + orange-jacket arm, legs of 1-2 bystanders in the background; no faces (a fur hood edge at the top-right at 0 s only)
notes: Vertical phone clip, source 720x1280 upscaled to 1080x1920. Clear black Baikal ice full of white crack lines. Crater centre x~0.5, y~0.58. Shot A 0.3-2.9 (first strikes), shot B 3.2-5.8 (big crater bursts).
